ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering and supply chain fraud risk detection platform that combines graph intelligence, Focal LightGBM, and explainable AI to protect local regional logistics networks.
ideas.title: Athens-Clemson Local Supply Chain Risk & Graph Intelligence Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy data science engineering patterns similar to Bito, combining complex graph intelligence and machine learning models which traditionally capture the technical edge with judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool designed to track land-use compliance, environmental changes, and agricultural zoning violations specifically tailored for Georgia's extensive farming and rural regions.
ideas.title: Local Agricultural Satellite Land Compliance & Monitoring Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring and geospatial AI to solve practical regulatory and industrial challenges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support and facility energy management platform combining LangGraph, RAG, and personalized AI agents to optimize energy consumption across university campus micro-grids.
ideas.title: Autonomous Regional Micro-Grid & Green Energy Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly upon the multi-agent system architecture seen in Greennovation, targeting sustainability themes which resonate well with regional utility initiatives.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform that delivers personalized meal recommendations using local dining hall menus, nutritional insights, and healthy lifestyle guidance for students.
ideas.title: Georgia Campus Health & Nutrition Personalization Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the practical consumer utility and rapid execution model of E-Foodiee, focusing on a hyper-relevant student demographic pain point during the 71-hour sprint.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow payments on Base, enabling student clubs to transparently fund, request, and execute event service contracts without administrative friction.
ideas.title: Decentralized Campus Event & Micro-Grant Autonomous Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements real blockchain utility via autonomous escrow mechanisms proven successful in the Dispatch project, showing hard systems integration rather than abstract concepts.
